label: DR-003
note: Simple domain models are covered through the component-test layer rather than isolated unit tests; the absence of a dedicated unit-test file is intentional and reviewer must NOT flag it as missing unit tests.

known_false_positive.title: Missing unit tests for WaypointSequence
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: The new ordering and empty-sequence validation in Create has no unit test in this change, so a regression in the waypoint ordering would ship unnoticed. Add a WaypointSequenceTests class covering ordering and the empty case.
